title: HealthRule
description: A health rule that defines performance thresholds and conditions for triggering violations on monitored entities.

id.description: The internal numeric identifier for the health rule.

name.description: The name of the health rule.

enabled.description: Whether the health rule is currently enabled.

useDataFromLastNMinutes.description: The evaluation time window in minutes.

waitTimeAfterViolation.description: Time in minutes to wait after a violation before re-evaluating.

scheduleName.description: The schedule that determines when this health rule is active.

affects.description: The entity scope affected by this health rule including affected entity type and selection criteria.

evalCriterias.description: The evaluation criteria containing critical and warning conditions with their metric thresholds.
